Repo: /home/mudathir/all/cvc5/mudathir (cvc5 SMT solver, branch lazy).
Goal: in src/theory/arith/liastar/liastar_extension.cpp, replace the per-lambda incremental
subsolver with enumeration in the MAIN solver: fresh integer skolems y for the lambda's bound
variables, a boolean guard skolem h (decision variable, phase-preferred true), lemmas
h => base(y) and h => not(D_i(y)) sent via TheoryArith's InferenceManager, the next cell read
from the main solver's candidate arithmetic model, and completeness detected when h is forced
false at decision level 0. Answer the specific questions for your assigned area with exact
signatures and file:line references. Return raw facts, not prose essays.
Area: how the arithModel passed to LiaStarExtension::checkFullEffort is built. Trace the caller chain:
src/theory/arith/theory_arith.cpp (search for checkFullEffort / liastar), nonlinear_extension.cpp if
relevant, and where the model map comes from (linear solver collectModelValues?). Questions:
1. Does the map contain values for ALL arithmetic variables known to the linear solver, including fresh
   skolems that appear only in theory lemmas (not in user assertions)? Under what conditions can a
   variable be MISSING from that map (eliminated by substitution, not in termSet, etc.)?
2. Are the mapped values always constants (Rational)?
3. How does the existing model-value shortcut in checkFullEffort substitute and rewrite to evaluate
   formulas under this model -- can the same substitute+rewrite evaluate an arbitrary QF_LIA atom over
   the skolems to a boolean constant reliably?

input.description: Check model cache member declarations in theory_arith.h

facts: CALLER CHAIN: TheoryArith::postCheck (src/theory/arith/theory_arith.cpp:251) at Theory::fullEffort, AFTER the linear solver succeeded (d_internal.postCheck(level) returned false at :268 and !d_im.hasSent() at :273), clears d_arithModelCache/d_arithModelCacheIllTyped/d_arithModelCacheSubs (:280-283), creates an empty std::set<Node> termSet (:284), calls updateModelCache(termSet) (:289), then d_liaStarExtension->checkFullEffort(d_arithModelCache, termSet) (:292). The liastar call happens BEFORE d_nonlinearExtension->checkFullEffort (:306) and BEFORE sanityCheckIntegerModel() (:326) and finalizeModelCache() (:329).

MAP CONSTRUCTION: TheoryArith::updateModelCache(std::set<Node>& termSet) (theory_arith.cpp:532) calls collectAssertedTermsForModel(termSet) then updateModelCacheInternal(termSet) (theory_arith.cpp:540) which calls d_internal.collectModelValues(termSet, d_arithModelCache, d_arithModelCacheIllTyped) (theory_arith.cpp:545). d_arithModelCache is std::map<Node, Node> (theory_arith.h:197); ill-typed map at theory_arith.h:199.

TERMSET: Theory::collectAssertedTermsForModel(std::set<Node>& termSet, bool includeShared = true) (src/theory/theory.cpp:346, decl theory.h:564) collects all subterms of facts currently asserted to TheoryArith (facts_begin()..facts_end(), theory.cpp:326-331) plus shared terms (theory.cpp:333-344), via Theory::collectTerms (theory.cpp:355) which traverses children of NOT, EQUAL, and arith-owned terms, skips closures (!cur.isClosure(), theory.cpp:378-379), and excludes nodes whose kind is in TheoryModel::getIrrelevantKinds() (NOT, EQUAL by default theory_model.cpp:69-70; STAR_CONTAINS is added as irrelevant at theory_arith.cpp:97 -- but irrelevance only suppresses adding the node itself; its arith children are still traversed).

FILTER IN LINEAR SOLVER: TheoryArithPrivate::collectModelValues(const std::set<Node>& termSet, std::map<Node, Node>& arithModel, std::map<Node, Node>& arithModelIllTyped) (src/theory/arith/linear/theory_arith_private.cpp:4561, decl theory_arith_private.h:485) iterates only over ArithVars known to the linear solver (var_begin()..var_end(), :4585) and includes term = d_partialModel.asNode(v) only if: NOT isAuxiliaryVariable(v) (:4589, slack vars skipped), AND (theoryOf(term)==THEORY_ARITH OR term is a shared term) AND termSet.find(term)!=termSet.end() (:4593-4594). It asserts AlwaysAssert(d_qflraStatus == Result::SAT) (:4566).

ANSWER Q1 (missing variables): the map does NOT unconditionally contain all linear-solver variables. A variable v is MISSING from arithModel when: (a) v is not a subterm of any fact currently asserted to TheoryArith and not a shared term, hence not in termSet (theory_arith_private.cpp:4594) -- a fresh skolem appearing only in a lemma is present IFF at least one atom containing it has been assigned by the SAT solver and asserted to arith; for a lemma clause (~h OR base(y)-atoms), if h is true unit propagation forces the base(y) atoms so y IS in termSet/model; if h is false the atoms may stay unassigned under partial-assignment decision modes; (b) v was never preregistered/setup as an ArithVar (no atom over v ever reached the linear solver); (c) v is an auxiliary (slack) variable (theory_arith_private.cpp:4589); (d) v is an integer variable assigned a non-integral rational: it goes to arithModelIllTyped instead of arithModel (theory_arith_private.cpp:4600-4614) and at the time liastar runs sanityCheckIntegerModel has NOT yet repaired this (it runs at theory_arith.cpp:326, after :292); (e) v was eliminated by ppAssert/top-level substitution so it never occurs in asserted facts -- cannot happen for fresh skolems introduced after preprocessing.

Q1 DECISION-MODE NUANCE: whether all lemma atoms are assigned at full effort depends on options::decision::decisionMode. For the logics in which LiaStarExtension exists (TheoryArith::finishInit creates it only when logic is arith-enabled and !logic.isLinear(), theory_arith.cpp:94-100), SetDefaults::setDefaultDecisionMode (src/smt/set_defaults.cpp:1810-1877) yields DecisionMode::INTERNAL for e.g. QF_NIA (none of the JUSTIFICATION conditions at :1820-1845 match a quantifier-free pure-nonlinear-arith logic), so MiniSat produces a complete assignment at full effort and every preregistered arith atom (including lemma atoms over the skolems y and under guard h of either polarity) is asserted to TheoryArith -- so y lands in termSet and in arithModel. Under JUSTIFICATION/STOPONLY (user-set or strings/quantified logics) atoms in already-satisfied lemma clauses can stay unassigned and y can be absent.

FALLBACK FOR MISSING VALUES: TheoryArith::getCandidateModelValue(TNode var) (theory_arith.cpp:511) first looks up d_arithModelCache (:514) and otherwise falls back to d_internal.getCandidateModelValue(var) (TheoryArithPrivate::getCandidateModelValue, theory_arith_private.cpp:1080) which computes the delta-substituted assignment and returns nm->mkConstRealOrInt(term.getType(), qmodel) or Node::null() on DeltaRationalException/ModelException (:1089-1096). This is the robust way to read the next-cell values for skolems y.

ANSWER Q2 (values are constants): yes, at the point liastar receives the map every mapped value is a constant: theory_arith_private.cpp:4597 computes Rational qmodel = mod.substituteDelta(delta) and stores nm->mkConstReal(qmodel) (:4605, non-integral case, real-typed keys only -- integral-typed keys with non-integral values are diverted to arithModelIllTyped :4612) or nm->mkConstRealOrInt(term.getType(), qmodel) (:4618). Types match keys (AssertEqual in sanityCheckIntegerModel theory_arith.cpp:575). Note the KEYS are not only variables: any non-auxiliary ArithVar node, including non-leaf arith terms (e.g. NONLINEAR_MULT, div/mod abstractions registered via setupAtom), appears as a key; leaf-filtering only happens later in collectModelValues(TheoryModel*) (theory_arith.cpp:430) and finalizeModelCache (theory_arith.cpp:559). NonlinearExtension::checkFullEffort (nonlinear_extension.cpp:241) may later mutate/erase entries (getModelValueRepair :317, d_trSlv.postProcessModel :322), but that runs after liastar.

ANSWER Q3 (substitute+rewrite shortcut): the existing shortcut is liastar_extension.cpp:362-401 (guarded by options().arith.arithLiaStarModelValue, option defined in src/options/arith_options.toml:612): it flattens arithModel into parallel keys/values vectors (:368-375), builds check = vectorPredicate OR d_lastStarLia[literal] (:381-383), then Node value = check.substitute(keys.begin(), keys.end(), values.begin(), values.end()) followed by value = rewrite(value) (:385-387) and compares value == d_true (:391). For an arbitrary QF_LIA atom (comparisons over +, -, constant multiplication, integer constants) this is reliable IFF every free variable of the atom is a key in arithModel: substitution then yields a ground constant-only arith atom which the rewriter fully evaluates, and boolean connectives over constants fold, so the result is exactly d_true or d_false. If ANY free variable is missing from the map the result is a residual non-constant node (== neither d_true nor d_false); the current code treats that conservatively as 'not satisfied' and falls through to refinement (:402-410). Bound variables under closures are safe: Node::substitute is applied to vectorPredicate which is already the beta-reduced/instantiated predicate p[v] from LiaStarUtils::getVectorPredicate (liastar_extension.cpp:336-337), not the raw lambda.

ENTRY POINT SIGNATURE: void LiaStarExtension::checkFullEffort(std::map<Node, Node>& arithModel, const std::set<Node>& termSet) (src/theory/arith/liastar/liastar_extension.cpp:313, decl liastar_extension.h:109). It receives arithModel by non-const reference but currently only reads it. getAssertions (liastar_extension.cpp:287) pulls STAR_CONTAINS literals of both polarities from d_arith.facts_begin()..facts_end().
signatures: void TheoryArithPrivate::collectModelValues(const std::set<Node>& termSet, std::map<Node, Node>& arithModel, std::map<Node, Node>& arithModelIllTyped) -- src/theory/arith/linear/theory_arith_private.cpp:4561, decl theory_arith_private.h:485
void Theory::collectAssertedTermsForModel(std::set<Node>& termSet, bool includeShared = true) const -- src/theory/theory.cpp:346, decl src/theory/theory.h:564
void Theory::collectTerms(TNode n, std::set<Node>& termSet, const std::set<Kind>& irrKinds) const -- src/theory/theory.cpp:355
void LiaStarExtension::checkFullEffort(std::map<Node, Node>& arithModel, const std::set<Node>& termSet) -- src/theory/arith/liastar/liastar_extension.cpp:313, decl liastar_extension.h:109
void NonlinearExtension::checkFullEffort(std::map<Node, Node>& arithModel, const std::set<Node>& termSet) -- src/theory/arith/nl/nonlinear_extension.cpp:241
caveats: Skolems under the guard h are only guaranteed to be in arithModel when at least one atom containing them was assigned and asserted to TheoryArith. Default decision mode for the liastar-enabled (nonlinear) quantifier-free arith logics is INTERNAL (complete SAT assignments), but with --decision=justification/stoponly or richer logics (strings, quantifiers, ALL), atoms in satisfied lemma clauses can remain unassigned and the skolems will be absent from the map. The enumeration code should fall back to TheoryArith::getCandidateModelValue or treat missing skolem values explicitly rather than assume presence.

Integer variables can transiently receive non-integral values: they are diverted to d_arithModelCacheIllTyped and are MISSING from the arithModel map at the time LiaStarExtension::checkFullEffort runs, because sanityCheckIntegerModel (which sends branch-and-bound lemmas) only runs afterwards (theory_arith.cpp:326 vs :292). Rare, but a robust evaluator must not assume an integer skolem key is present.

The substitute+rewrite shortcut yields d_true/d_false only when all free variables of the formula are covered by the map; a missing variable silently produces a non-constant residual, which the current code conservatively treats as 'model does not satisfy'. If the new enumeration logic needs a definite boolean (e.g. to decide whether to emit the next not(D_i(y)) lemma), it must check that the rewritten result is actually a constant.

arithModel keys are arbitrary non-auxiliary ArithVar nodes, not only variables/skolems (non-leaf terms like NONLINEAR_MULT abstractions appear); when building the substitution restrict to leaves if exact-term substitution into deeper terms is a concern (cf. finalizeModelCache's Theory::isLeafOf filter at theory_arith.cpp:559).

checkFullEffort for liastar is only reached when the linear solver is SAT and no lemma was sent earlier in postCheck; d_im.hasSent()/d_im.hasSentLemma() short-circuits inside checkFullEffort (liastar_extension.cpp:356-361) mean the model-based code may not run every round.
Line numbers refer to branch 'lazy' at commit 574ed99b54 with an untracked liastar_lazy_pushpop_results.md; they will shift if the file is edited.
